subject: Implementation cadence & staging matrix — Spiral cutover plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@stellarus.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@stellarus.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation cadence & staging matrix — Spiral cutover plan

Hi Lena / Marco,

Congratulations again on signing — excited to get Stellarus into production. Per our contract, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation milestones: canary windows, staged migration lanes, training, and acceptance gates. This note lays out the initial cadence and asks for confirmation on two items so we can finalize the MAP this week:

1) Canary window preference: weekend short window (Sat 02:00–06:00 PT) vs weekday late-night (Tue 23:30–02:30 PT).
2) Training cohort: do you want the pilot cohort to be the Platform Ops team (recommended) or include Product first?

Attached: MAP-SpiralCutover-v1.pdf (MAP + milestone matrix) and a draft Training-Agenda-Week1.xlsx.

High-level proposed sequence (week numbers counted from sig+1):
- Week 0: Pre-provisioning & access verification (networks, KMS test vectors)
- Week 1: Canary lane 1 (1 node pool, 1% traffic routing) + pilot training (Platform Ops)
- Week 2: Canary lane 2 (broader dataset, KV cache warm-up) + incident runbook dry run
- Week 3: Full migration staging (bulk data sync) and acceptance tests

I’ve looped in Priyom for the detailed cutover choreography and Vanessa for CS handoff / training logistics. If you can confirm the canary window and training cohort by EOD Monday (June 28), we’ll lock the dates and publish the MAP for signatures.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP-SpiralCutover-v1.pdf (PDF, 14 pages), Training-Agenda-Week1.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation cadence & staging matrix — Spiral cutover plan

Karthik — thanks, this looks good and thorough. A few quick answers:

- Canary window: prefer weekend window (Sat 02:00–06:00 PT). Less business impact for us.
- Training cohort: start with Platform Ops. We’ll include Product in week 2 as observers.

Two asks from my side before you finalize:
1) Add a row for compliance evidence collection (SOC2 artifacts and access logs) during Week 0 — we need that for our audit team.
2) For the canary rollback plan, can you add the automatic fallback criteria (error % thresholds and latency deltas) so our SREs know the triggers?

I’m available Mon morning for a 30-min sync if you want to walk through the MAP.

Best,
Lena Park

lena.park@stellarus.com | +1 617-555-7890

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation cadence & staging matrix — Spiral cutover plan

Thanks for the confirmations, Lena — noted on weekend window and Platform Ops. I’ve updated the attached MAP (see MAP-SpiralCutover-v1.pdf) with two additions: compliance evidence collection row in Week 0 and an initial rollback criteria section. Highlights from the rollback doc:

- Automatic fallback if 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained for 5 minutes OR median latency increases > 40% over baseline (60s window).
- Manual abort if memory/CPU or KV cache miss rates exceed thresholds for two consecutive monitoring intervals.
- Canary traffic ramp schedule: 1% -> 5% -> 15% -> 50% over 6 hours, with observability gates at each step.

Proposed canary ops checklist (Week 1):
- Pre-canary runbook review (SRE + Redwood runtime engineer)
- Smoke-level acceptance tests (latency, generation-quality sampling against eval set)
- KMS rotate test (mock key)
- Initial KV cache warm-up via replayed recent queries

I’ve attached the updated Training-Agenda-Week1.xlsx with suggested exercises for the Platform Ops cohort and a 2-hour lab on canary rollback drills. Please review and let me know if we should nudge any thresholds.

Attaching: MAP-SpiralCutover-v1.pdf (rev 1 included inline changes), Training-Agenda-Week1.xlsx

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
